data.name: TermMetaverseText
data.value: The central, authoritative repository within JIM. The Metaverse holds one Metaverse Object for each real-world thing JIM manages, aggregated from every Connected System via Synchronization Rules.

data.name: TermConnectorSpaceText
data.value: The staging area where Connected System Objects reside before and after synchronization. The Connector Space acts as a buffer between external systems and the Metaverse, ensuring that changes are validated before they are applied.

data.name: TermProjectionText
data.value: Creating a new Metaverse Object when no existing one matches an incoming Connected System Object. Projection is enabled per Synchronization Rule.

data.name: TermAttributeFlowText
data.value: A rule that maps an attribute between a Connected System Object and a Metaverse Object. Attribute Flows define how data moves during synchronization, including any transformations applied via expressions.

data.name: TermPendingExportText
data.value: A queued change waiting to be sent to a target system. Pending Exports are created during synchronization and held until an export Run Profile is executed, at which point they are applied to the Connected System.

data.name: TermScopingText
data.value: The Scoping Criteria that decide which objects a Synchronization Rule applies to. While an object is outside them, the rule flows nothing for it; when a joined object leaves them, the rule's Out-of-Scope Action (import rules) or Deprovisioning Action (export rules) decides what happens next.

data.name: TermAttributePriorityText
data.value: The deterministic precedence that decides which Connected System's value wins when several contribute the same Metaverse Object attribute. Each contributing inbound Synchronization Rule holds a priority for the attribute, and the highest-priority contributor that has a value sets it, so the result never depends on the order synchronizations happen to run in.

data.name: PasswordFirstPasswordTooltip
data.value: This change is also the first password of a Connected System Object JIM provisioned while it was waiting. Delivering it applies the provisioning Synchronization Rule's Initial Password settings for enabling the Connected System Object and for whether its password never expires. Canceling it leaves that Connected System Object without a password from JIM.
